description: Call once right after you publish something on the user's own plug (one in list_plugins): a new plug, or a new action, trigger, version or connection on it. viaSocket then reviews the published plug and may add missing actions or triggers. Body: pluginId (the plug rowid, required), published (new_plug | new_action | new_trigger | new_version | connection), plus optional app (the app's name), actionIds (rowids of the actions or triggers just published) and note (plain words, never secrets). No need to ask the user; a failed call never stops the task. The org and user come from the sign-in. Not for problems: use report_feedback for those.

note.description: e.g. Published privately with 4 actions and 1 trigger; OAuth 2.0 connection

name: report_published
